title: INSPECTION OF GEAR HOUSING
ocr_text:
INSPECTION OF GEAR HOUSING

1. INSPECTION CONTROL VALVE
(a) Remove the control valve with pinion from the yoke housing.
(b) If necessary, replace the control valve assembly.

2. INSPECT STEERING RACK RUNOUT
Runout: Limit 0.3 mm (0.012 in.)

REPLACEMENT OF GEAR HOUSING
IF NECESSARY, REPLACE FOLLOWING PARTS:

1. OIL SEAL FOR RACK HOUSING
(a) Remove the oil seal with a screwdriver.
(b) Using SST, install the new oil seal.
SST 09620-30010 (09631-00020)
SST 09630-24013 (09631-24070)

2. OIL SEAL FOR CYLINDER HOUSING
(a) Using SST, drive out the oil seal.
(b) Using SST and a hammer, install a new oil seal.
SST 09620-30010 (09625-30010, 09631-00020)
• Install the new oil seal.
• Place the spacer on the oil seal.
• Drive in the oil seal over the spacer until the round surface of SST is flush with housing surface.

3. OIL SEAL AND BEARING FOR CONTROL VALVE HOUSING
(a) Remove the snap ring.
(b) Remove the bearing and oil seal with brass bar.
